description: Fetch an agency's fiscal-year overview including mission, budgetary resources, obligation and outlay totals (for the most recent fiscal year with reported budget data), sub-agency count, and DEF codes for disaster/emergency funding. Also returns a paginated sub-agency breakdown with obligation and transaction counts for the same fiscal year as the budget totals (the current fiscal year when no budget year is available within 5 seconds); sub_agency_fiscal_year names the year it covers. Accepts exactly one of a 3-digit toptier_code (e.g., 097 for DoD, 012 for Agriculture) or an agency_slug (e.g., department-of-defense) — both appear in usaspending_list_agencies results and award search results. When the budget or sub-agency request fails, the overview is still returned and unavailable_sections names each missing section with its reason.

agency_slug.description: URL-friendly agency slug (e.g., department-of-defense) — from usaspending_list_agencies or award search results. Use either toptier_code or agency_slug, not both.

page.description: Sub-agency breakdown page (1-based, 10 per page). Use with sub_agency_page_metadata.has_next to page through the full list.

toptier_code.description: 3-digit toptier agency code (e.g., 097, 012) — from usaspending_list_agencies. Use either toptier_code or agency_slug, not both.

name: usaspending_get_agency

budgetary_resources_amount.description: Total budgetary resources in USD for the fiscal year

def_codes.description: Disaster/Emergency Funding (DEF) codes applicable to this agency

items.description: DEF code entry with public law and title

code.description: DEF code identifying an emergency supplemental

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `agency_not_found`: No agency found for the given toptier_code or agency_slug. `missing_input`: Neither toptier_code nor agency_slug was provided. `conflicting_input`: Both toptier_code and agency_slug were provided. `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year the budgetary totals below reflect: the most recent year with reported budget data, which can trail the current fiscal year (a new year has no amounts until the agency first reports in it)

has_more_sub_agencies.description: Whether more sub-agency pages are available. Absent when the sub-agency request failed, since pagination is then unknown.

notice.description: How to page for more sub-agencies when the breakdown is truncated, and which sections failed to load and whether a retry may recover them. Absent when neither applies.

obligated_amount.description: Total amount obligated in USD for the fiscal year

outlay_amount.description: Total outlays in USD for the fiscal year

sub_agencies.description: Sub-agency breakdown within this toptier agency (one page)

items.description: Sub-agency entry with obligations and transaction counts

sub_agency_fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year the sub-agency breakdown covers, as upstream reports it: the same year as fiscal_year, or the current fiscal year when no budget year was available within 5 seconds — so it can differ from fiscal_year even when both are present. Absent when the sub-agency request failed, or when upstream reports no year for a breakdown requested without one.

sub_agency_page.description: Current sub-agency page returned. Absent when the sub-agency request failed.

sub_agency_page_metadata.description: Pagination metadata for the sub-agency breakdown

has_next.description: Whether more sub-agency pages are available

sub_agency_total.description: Total sub-agencies across all pages (when available)

subtier_agency_count.description: Number of sub-agencies within this toptier agency

unavailable_sections.description: Sections omitted because their request failed while the agency overview loaded. Absent when every section loaded.

items.description: A section omitted from the result because its request failed

message.description: The failure message for this section.

reason.description: api_unavailable: USAspending was unreachable or answered with a server error. api_timeout: no answer before the request deadline. upstream_error: USAspending rejected the request.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the call may load this section.

section.description: budgetary_resources: fiscal_year and the budget, obligation, and outlay totals. sub_agencies: the sub-agency breakdown and its pagination.

title: Get Agency Overview
